name: pi project trust (trust-manager, project-trust)
copiedPaths: trust-manager.ts ProjectTrustStore, findNearestTrustEntry, readTrustFile, writeTrustFile, getProjectTrustOptions -> src/loading-trust/trust/store.ts
notCopied: trust-manager.ts acquireTrustLockSync, withTrustFileLock (138-177) and the proper-lockfile import (locking belongs to the TrustStoreBackend implementation)
trust-manager.ts getProjectTrustParentPath (inlined as parentOf in resolve.ts)
project-trust.ts formatProjectTrustPrompt, selectProjectTrustOption, saveProjectTrustPromptResult (display belongs to the L4 TrustPrompter)
project-trust.ts AppMode, ResolveProjectTrustedOptions.extensionsResult/projectTrustContext/onExtensionError (replaced by LoaderMode, TrustPrompter and the emitProjectTrust argument)
modifications: verdict-type: boolean | null decisions become the three-valued TrustVerdict (allow, deny, undecided) (store.ts)
trust-file-schema: the stored file is { version: 1, entries: { path: { verdict, decidedAt, via } } } checked by TrustFileSchema (store.ts)
store-errors: setMany returns Result<void, TrustStoreError> (corrupt, io) instead of throwing (store.ts)
strip-bom-local: stripBom from utils/text.ts becomes a local function (store.ts)
corrupt-as-value: a store that cannot be read or parsed is TrustLookup corrupt instead of a thrown error (store.ts)
pi-v0-format: a pi file (Record<path, boolean | null>) is read as version 0 and rewritten as version 1 on the next write (store.ts)
injected-normalize: canonicalizePath/resolvePath become the normalize constructor argument (store.ts)
async-backend: node:fs sync reads and writes become the async TrustStoreBackend port (store.ts)
no-lockfile: proper-lockfile and the busy-wait lock are removed; TrustStoreBackend.update does the locked read-modify-write (store.ts)
options-localized: getProjectTrustOptions returns five TrustOption values with label identifiers and no display text (store.ts)
config-dir-constant: CONFIG_DIR_NAME from config.ts becomes the local constant .xeon (resources.ts)
resource-list: the trust-requiring resource list uses the Xeon names of spec section 4.7.2 (resources.ts)
find-list: the boolean check returns the list of resources that were found (resources.ts)
injected-fs-home: existsSync/homedir/process.env.HOME become LoaderFs and the homeDir argument (resources.ts)
decision-order: the order keeps pi's and adds session memory, store corruption and headless denial; verdicts are allow, deny, undecided (resolve.ts)
point-fail-closed: an exception from the project_trust point denies instead of being reported and skipped (resolve.ts)
corrupt-store-no-prompt: a corrupt store denies without prompting so a saved answer cannot overwrite other folders' decisions (resolve.ts)
prompter-port: ctx.ui.select and hasUI become the TrustPrompter port and the headless mode (resolve.ts)
tracking: Not tracked. New pi releases are not followed. Record any hand-ported fix here with the upstream version and function.
